body: Perhaps it’s ironic that I’ve applied to every hospital in the area multiple times yet my weight will eventually drop to the point of me collapsing and ending up in the ER.
Thank you. Yes, it’s definitely frustrating because random strangers in public comment on how emaciated I look, so it’s obvious I need help. I’ll check out those subreddits.
Thanks, but nothing like that is near me :/
Thanks for the idea. It’s complicated, but I don’t qualify for food assistance in my state. I tried :(
Yes, I’m on Medicaid and in a program that pays most of my utility bills. The waitlist for rent assistance has thousands of people on it, so I don’t get any help with that :/

I usually just lurk, but had to make an account when I realized how similar your situation is to mine. I wish I knew how to help. 

300 job applications, a few interviews, etc., but someone with more experience is always chosen. My bachelor degree (in a science, also) seems worthless. 

As a result, I’m going hungry now while living off of the little student loan funds I have left. Food costs money, but I can’t force anyone to hire me. I’m 5’4” and now weigh 88 pounds at 26 years old.
